A:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE production animation sprite atlas for the EVOLVE game, transparent PNG, 1536 x 1152 pixels. EXACTLY FOUR equal-width columns and THREE equal-height rows: 12 complete creatures total, one creature per cell. No drawn grid, labels, text, watermark.
Image 1: rendering STYLE and motion reference only. Images 2-4: exact monster identity references for the three rows. Re-render those three identities with realistic detailed game quality matching image 1. Do not copy any of image 1's creature designs.
Row 1: WARDEN from image 2: pale ivory broad layered armor carapace, four stout dark clawed legs, low head, oversized curved ivory mandibles; wide compact armored beetle silhouette.
Row 2: SYMBIOTE from image 3: long pale segmented scorpion body, purple organic sac on its back, hooked curled tail over its back, black curved pincer arms; keep its tail and purple sac.
Row 3: EMBERMAW from image 4: thick pale plated insectoid quadruped, orange burning throat and jaws, dark hooked forelegs, heavy arched back.
Every row has these FOUR columns, left to right: 1 grounded neutral passing gait pose; 2 clearly visible left limbs stepping forward while right limbs push backward; 3 opposite stepping pose with visibly different articulated limb silhouettes; 4 aggressive attack/recoil pose with jaws open and head/chest/forelimbs extended. Draw true anatomical pose changes, not rotated or stretched copies. Keep identity and anatomy consistent across each row: same number of limbs, same carapace, same details, identical body and head scale, same camera angle and lighting. No added effects, projectiles or particles.
High fidelity realistic pre-rendered 3D biological horror monsters: worn ivory chitin, wet dark tendons, sharp claws, detailed materials and strong readable silhouette, subtle red enemy rim, soft upper-left lighting. Preserve the specified creature colors and distinctive anatomy. Avoid cartoon or simplified illustration.
All creatures viewed three-quarter from above, facing down-right as in the references. Each creature is entirely inside its own cell with generous transparent padding, no cut-off limbs or overlap into adjacent cells. Each body occupies about 78% of its cell width and 75% height. Feet share a consistent baseline within each row. All 12 cutouts must have GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background and alpha, no floor, no shadow rectangle, no backdrop.
